description: This file defines the VoiceWakeGlobalSettingsSync class responsible for synchronizing voice wake settings with a backend gateway. It manages a background task that periodically refreshes triggers, subscribes to push updates, and applies changes to app state.

classes.name: VoiceWakeGlobalSettingsSync
classes.description: A singleton class managing synchronization of voice wake settings with a remote gateway, handling background tasks, streaming updates, and applying trigger configurations.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the background task that continuously refreshes and listens for updates from the gateway.

methods.name: refreshFromGateway
methods.description: Fetches the latest voice wake triggers from the gateway and updates local app state.

methods.name: handle(push:)
methods.description: Handles incoming push events related to voice wake changes, decoding payloads and updating app state.
